rationale: Both reviews are exceptionally thorough and well-grounded, independently converging on several of the same real issues (image→frame silent breakage, missing duration/fps mismatch for MiniMax-H3, hardcoded snapshot path in the example workflow, stale model_params['type'] comment). The key differentiator is the ground truth's core concern: lookup_model_spec path-matching fragility. X directly demonstrates (with a worked test table) a genuine remaining failure mode ('MiniMax-H3/Ref2VA' with no org prefix), landing squarely on the ground truth's theme even though the specific scenario differs; Y explicitly investigated the same lines and confidently marked them '[resolved]', missing the edge case entirely. Y compensates with a few unique, well-evidenced catches (mov/mp4 mismatch, mocked-test blind spot hiding the fps=24 pipeline check) and arguably tighter evidence citation, keeping precision comparable, but its false 'resolved' verdict on the exact matter the ground truth reviewer flagged costs it recall.
